# Ollama Management

This layer is responsible for managing Ollama releases and models, including hashing archive files, updating model pinning, and computing checksums.

## Overview

The Ollama Management layer includes scripts to handle various tasks related to Ollama releases and models. It ensures that all necessary files are correctly hashed, model pinning is updated, and checksums are computed.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists files in an Ollama release archive. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model pinning digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes release and model digests. |  |

## How it works

- `scripts/archive-hashes.js`:
  - Defines functions to hash archive files (`hashArchive`, `hashTar`).
  - Lists files in an Ollama release archive (`wanted`, `field`).

- `scripts/update-models.js`:
  - Records model pinning digests (`fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`).

- `scripts/update-ollama.sh`:
  - Computes release and model digests.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
